answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making reputation a scarce, earned asset. Each newcomer stakes collateral, takes unpredictable assignments, and collects attestations from reviewers chosen outside its own circle. A plume of trust appears only after repeated independent verification, a pulse of reward is capped per identity, and a violet trail records every signed result so copied behavior is visible. Audits slash fraudulent bonds, so multiplying identities raises cost, never credibility.
